MacroName wizard_optics

##################DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING IN THIS SCRIPT!#############
# Name: wizard_optics
# Author: Simon Fromm
# Version: 1.0.1
# SerialEM version: 4.2.X or higher
# Last update: 18.06.2026
# Support: simon.fromm@embl.de
# DOES NOT WORK AS STANDALONE. Needs to be called via the LowDoseWizard script
###################################################################

SuppressReports

Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Starting LowDoseWizard OPTICS routine
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo

#################################################
# Read in optics config file
#################################################

ReportSystemPath
ReadStringsFromFile optics $repVal1\wizard_optics_config.txt
CallStringArray optics

#################################################
# Check if parameter file from previous session is present
#################################################

ReportDirectory
dir = $repVal1
DoesFileExist $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
If $repVal1 == 0
   paramfile = 0
   reload = 0
   SkipTo Prompts
Elseif $repVal1 == 1
   paramfile = 1
   YesNoBox A LowDoseWizard parameters file has been found inside the current working directory. Do you want to use it instead of defining new parameters?
   If $repVal1 == 1
      Echo Using existing parameters file.
      ReadStringsFromFile param $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
      CallStringArray param
      IsVariableDefined magR
      If $repVal1 == 0
         OKBox A faulty or incomplete parameter file has been loaded. It's best to delete the file and restart the LowDoseWizard.
         Exit  A faulty or incomplete parameter file has been loaded. It's best to delete the file and restart the LowDoseWizard.
      Endif
      reload = 1
      SkipTo Execution
   Elseif $repVal1 == 0
      reload = 0
      SkipTo Prompts
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# User prompts
#################################################
Prompts:

If $EnableTomo == 0
   type := 2
Else
   ParseQuotedStrings 1
   header = { 'Is this a' }
   prompt1 = { '1: Tomo OR' }
   prompt2 = { '2: SPA session?' }
   buttons = { '1:Tomo' '2: SPA'}
   ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 buttons
   If $repVal1 == 1
      Echo This is a Tomo session.
      type := 1
   ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
      Echo This is a SPA session.
      type := 2
   Endif
Endif

If $type == 1
   EnterDefaultedNumber $Mag_tomo_$Mag_tomo_default -1 Enter the Record mag in kx: ($Pix_tomo_0 A/px -> $Mag_tomo_0 kx; \
   $Pix_tomo_1 -> $Mag_tomo_1; $Pix_tomo_2 -> $Mag_tomo_2; $Pix_tomo_3 -> $Mag_tomo_3; $Pix_tomo_4 -> $Mag_tomo_4)
   mag_R := $repVal1
   magR := $mag_R * 1000
   IsVariableDefined SpotR_$magR
   If $repVal1 == 0
      configured = 0
   Else
      configured = 1
   Endif
   If $configured == 0
      OKBox Chosen Record mag is not configured. Please choose a configured Record mag.
      Echo Chosen Record mag is not configured. Please choose a configured Record mag.
      EnterDefaultedNumber $Mag_tomo_$Mag_tomo_default -1 Enter the Record mag in kx: ($Pix_tomo_0 A/px -> $Mag_tomo_0 kx; \
      $Pix_tomo_1 -> $Mag_tomo_1; $Pix_tomo_2 -> $Mag_tomo_2; $Pix_tomo_3 -> $Mag_tomo_3; $Pix_tomo_4 -> $Mag_tomo_4)
      mag_R := $repVal1
      magR := $mag_R * 1000
      IsVariableDefined SpotR_$magR
      If $repVal1 == 0
         configured = 0
      Else
         configured = 1
      Endif
      If $configured == 0
         OKBox Chosen Record mag is not configured. LowDoseWizard is aborted.
         Exit Chosen Record mag is not configured. LowDoseWizard is aborted.
      Endif
   Endif
   Echo Record mag chosen to be $mag_R kx.
   ParseQuotedStrings 1
   header = { 'How much detailed do you need in the lamella/square maps? This will define your Search magnification.'}
   prompt1 = { '1: I want to see lots of details ($Mag_lamella_0 x).' }
   prompt2 = { '2: Fine if I can recognize some shapes ($Mag_lamella_1 x).' }
   prompt3 = { '3: Fine as long as I see something ($Mag_lamella_2 x).' }
   buttons = { '1: High' '2: Medium' '3: Low' }
   ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 prompt3 buttons
   If $repVal1 == 1
      magS := $Mag_lamella_0
      Echo Lamella/square maps will be acquired at the same mag as View ($Mag_lamella_0 x).
   ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
      magS := $Mag_lamella_1
      Echo Lamella/square maps will be acquired at $Mag_lamella_1 x.
   ElseIf $repVal1 == 3
      magS := $Mag_lamella_2
      Echo Lamella/square maps will be acquired with the lowest SA mag ($Mag_lamella_2 x).
   Endif
   ParseQuotedStrings 0
ElseIf $type == 2
   EnterDefaultedNumber $Mag_SPA_$Mag_SPA_default -1 Enter the Record magnification in kx: ($Pix_SPA_0 A/px -> $Mag_SPA_0 kx; \
   $Pix_SPA_1 -> $Mag_SPA_1; $Pix_SPA_2 -> $Mag_SPA_2; $Pix_SPA_3 -> $Mag_SPA_3)
   mag_R := $repVal1
   magR := $mag_R * 1000
   IsVariableDefined SpotR_$magR
   If $repVal1 == 0
      configured = 0
   Else
      configured = 1
   Endif
   If $configured == 0
      OKBox Chosen Record mag is not configured. Please choose a configured Record mag.
      Echo Chosen Record mag is not configured. Please choose a configured Record mag.
      EnterDefaultedNumber $Mag_SPA_$Mag_SPA_default -1 Enter the Record magnification in kx: ($Pix_SPA_0 A/px -> $Mag_SPA_0 kx; \
      $Pix_SPA_1 -> $Mag_SPA_1; $Pix_SPA_2 -> $Mag_SPA_2; $Pix_SPA_3 -> $Mag_SPA_3)
      mag_R := $repVal1
      magR := $mag_R * 1000
      IsVariableDefined SpotR_$magR
      If $repVal1 == 0
         configured = 0
      Else
         configured = 1
      Endif
      If $configured == 0
         OKBox Chosen Record mag is not configured. LowDoseWizard is aborted.
         Exit Chosen Record mag is not configured. LowDoseWizard is aborted.
      Endif
   Endif
   Echo Record mag chosen to be $mag_R kx.
   EnterDefaultedNumber 1.2 1 Which nominal hole size does your grid have (in micrometer)?
   hole_size := $repVal1
   Echo Foil hole size chosen to be $hole_size um.
   ParseQuotedStrings 1
   header = { 'What support foil (NOT mesh) material does your grid have?' }
   prompt1 = { 'Carbon, e.g. Quantifoil or C-flat' }
   prompt2 = { 'Gold, e.g. UltrAuFoil or HexAuFoil' }
   buttons = { 'Carbon' 'Gold' }
   ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 buttons
   If $repVal1 == 1
      foil_type := 0
      Echo Foil material chosen to be carbon.
   ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
      foil_type := 1
      Echo Foil material chosen to be gold.
   Endif
   ParseQuotedStrings 0
   magS := $Mag_SA_low
Endif

#################################################
# Jump to here if parameter file is used
#################################################

Execution:

#################################################
# Retract objective aperture if inserted
#################################################

ReportApertureSize 2
If $repVal1 != 0
   SetApertureSize 2 0
Endif

#################################################
# Determine optimal view mag for given foil hole size
#################################################

If $type == 1
   magV = $Mag_V_low
Elseif $type == 2
   fov_view = $hole_size * 1000 * $FOV_V
   SuppressReports
   CameraProperties
   camera = $repVal6
   Loop 40 index
      CameraProperties $camera $index
      fov_index = $repVal1 * $repVal5
      If $fov_index <= $fov_view
         indV = $index - 1
         Break
      Endif
   EndLoop
   SetMagIndex $indV
   ReportMag
   magV = $repVal1
   If $magV < $Mag_V_low
      magV = $Mag_V_low
   Elseif $magV > $Mag_V_high
      magV = $Mag_V_high
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# Set spot size, C2 aperture size, C2 lens, minicondenser lens, defocus offset and energy filter slit width/offset
#################################################
# Record
spR = $SpotR_$magR
IsVariableDefined C2apertureR
If $repVal1 == 1
   c2apR = $C2apertureR
Else
   c2apR = $C2apertureR_$magR
Endif
c2R = $C2lensR_$magR-$spR-$c2apR
IsVariableDefined MiniR
If $repVal1 == 1
    probeR = $MiniR
Else
    probeR = $MiniR_$magR
Endif
wR = $EslitWidthR
oR = $EslitOffsetR

# View
spV = $spR
c2apV = $c2apR
c2V = $C2lensV_$magV-$spV-$c2apV
IsVariableDefined MiniV
If $repVal1 == 1
    probeV = $MiniV
Else
    probeV = $MiniV_$magV
Endif
wV = $EslitWidthV
oV = $EslitOffsetV

# Search
spS = $spR
IsVariableDefined C2apertureR
If $repVal1 == 1
   c2apS = $c2apR
Else
   c2apS = $C2apertureS_$magS
Endif
c2S = $C2lensS_$magS-$spS-$c2apS
IsVariableDefined MiniS
If $repVal1 == 1
    probeS = $MiniS
Else
    probeS = $MiniS_$magS
Endif

# Defocus offsets and energy filter settings
defR = $DefocusOffsetR
If $type == 1
   defV = $DefocusOffsetV
   defS = $DefocusOffsetS
   wS = $EslitWidthS
   oS = $EslitOffsetS
Elseif $type == 2
   If $foil_type == 0
      defV = $DefocusOffsetV
      defS = $DefocusOffsetS
      wS = $EslitWidthS
      oS = $EslitOffsetS
   Elseif $foil_type == 1
      defV = $DefocusOffsetV_gold
      wS = $EslitWidthS_plasmon
      oS = $EslitOffsetS_plasmon
      If $EnergyFilter == 1
         defS = $DefocusOffsetS_plasmon
      Else
         defS = $DefocusOffsetS_gold
      Endif
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# Check that Record C2 aperture is inserted
#################################################

ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apR
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apR
   Echo Inserted $c2apR micron C2 aperture.
Endif

#################################################
# Setup Low Dose in SerialEM
#################################################

SetLowDoseMode 1

SetLDDefocusOffset V $defV
SetLDDefocusOffset S $defS

MoveToNavItem $empty

# Record
CallFunction set_ld-area $magR $c2R $spR $probeR $defR $wR $oR R

# Reset beam shifts
If $type == 1
   SetUserSetting ShiftToTiltAxis 1 1
   ResetImageShift
   Delay 1 s
   SetLDContinuousUpdate 0
   SetProbeMode micro
   ResetImageShift
   Delay 1 s
   SetProbeMode nano
Elseif $type == 2
   SetUserSetting ShiftToTiltAxis 0 1
   SetBeamShift 0 0
   Delay 1 s
   SetLDContinuousUpdate 0
   SetProbeMode micro
   SetBeamShift 0 0
   Delay 1 s
   SetProbeMode nano
Endif

# Focus
SetLDContinuousUpdate 1
CopyLowDoseArea R F
UpdateLowDoseParams F 1
SetAxisPosition F 0 0

# Trial
CopyLowDoseArea R T
UpdateLowDoseParams T 1

# View
ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apV
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apV
   Echo Inserted $c2apV micron C2 aperture.
Endif
CallFunction set_ld-area $magV $c2V $spV $probeV $defV $wV $oV V

# Search
ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apS
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apS
   Echo Inserted $c2apS micron C2 aperture.
Endif
CallFunction set_ld-area $magS $c2S $spS $probeS $defS $wS $oS S

# Turn off continuous update
SetLDContinuousUpdate 0

#################################################
# Check on Flu Screen if empty area is actually empty
#################################################

SetColumnOrGunValve 1
ScreenDown
YesNoBox Is the 'empty' area actually empty (at least in the center)?
If $repVal1 == 0
   Pause Use the JOYSTICK on the right control pad to move the stage to an empty area. Use the TRACKBALL on the left control pad to center the beam if necessary. Then click Yes to continue.
   ChangeItemLabel $empty empty_old
   ReportStageXYZ
   AddStagePosAsNavPoint $repVal1 $repVal2 $repVal3
   ReportOtherItem -1
   empty := $repVal1
   ChangeItemLabel $empty empty
Endif

#################################################
# Set Beam shifts
#################################################

# Insert Record C2 aperture
ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apR
   Echo Inserting C2 $c2apR micron aperture.
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apR
Endif

# Set Record beam shift with direct alignments
GoToLowDoseArea R
SetDefocus $defR
Pause Please center the beam with DIRECT ALIGNMENTS --> Tomo Beam shift; Then click Yes to continue.

# Insert View C2 aperture
ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apV
   Echo Inserting C2 $c2apV micron aperture.
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apV
Endif

# Set View additional beam shift
GoToLowDoseArea V
SetLDAddedBeamButton
Pause Please center the beam with the left TRACKBALL; Then click Yes to continue.

# Insert Search C2 aperture
ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apS
   Echo Inserting C2 $c2apS micron aperture.
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apS
Endif

# Set Search additional beam shift
GoToLowDoseArea S
SetLDAddedBeamButton
Pause Please center the beam with the left TRACKBALL; Then click Yes to continue.
ScreenUp
SetLDAddedBeamButton 0
ReportApertureSize 1
If $repVal1 != $c2apR
   Echo Inserting C2 $c2apR micron aperture.
   SetApertureSize 1 $c2apR
Endif

GoToLowDoseArea R

#################################################
# Set Target Defocus
#################################################

If $type == 1
   SetTargetDefocus $TargetDefocus_tomo
Elseif $type == 2
   SetTargetDefocus $TargetDefocus_SPA
Endif

#################################################
# Set stage move on big mouse shifts
#################################################

SetUserSetting MoveStageOnBigMouseShift 1 1

#################################################
# Make variables persistent
#################################################

mag_V = $magV / 1000
mag_S = $magS / 1000

MakeVarPersistent spR
MakeVarPersistent c2R
MakeVarPersistent magV
MakeVarPersistent c2V
MakeVarPersistent defV
MakeVarPersistent c2S
MakeVarPersistent defS
MakeVarPersistent wR
MakeVarPersistent wS
MakeVarPersistent oS
MakeVarPersistent c2apR
MakeVarPersistent probeR

#################################################
# Write parameter file
#################################################

If $paramfile == 0
   OpenTextFile PAR O 1 $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
   SkipTo Writing
Elseif $paramfile == 1
   If $reload == 1
      SkipTo Finish
   ElseIf $reload == 0
      OpenTextFile PAR A 0 $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
      SkipTo Writing
   Endif
Endif

Writing:

WriteLineToFile PAR type := $type
WriteLineToFile PAR mag_R := $mag_R
WriteLineToFile PAR magR := $magR
WriteLineToFile PAR magS := $magS
If $type == 2
   WriteLineToFile PAR hole_size := $hole_size
   WriteLineToFile PAR foil_type := $foil_type
Endif

If $paramfile == 1
   If $reload == 0
      CloseTextFile PAR
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# Closing message
#################################################
Finish:

OKBox Completed LowDoseWizard OPTICS routine. Record mag is $mag_R kx; View mag is $mag_V kx; Search mag is $mag_S kx.
Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Completed LowDoseWizard OPTICS routine.
Echo Record mag is $mag_R kx; View mag is $mag_V kx; Search mag is $mag_S kx.
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo
